articles.title: Kalshi in talks with Sequoia, Wellington for $750 million fund raise at $40 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The prediction-market platform raised $1 billion at a $22 billion valuation in May and is now discussing a new round that could nearly double that figure.

articles.title: Kalshi Ordered to Block Washington Bets Days After CFTC Backed It
articles.snippet: A King County judge gave the exchange until August 19 to stop offering sports, election and politics wagers in the state.

articles.title: SpaceXAI Wants Grok Bot to Do Your Job—But It Needs Access to Your Accounts
